description: Per client x service-line x component routing that drives the D8 four-way invoice split WITHOUT code: which document each component lands on, whether the client receives it (present-set), and whether it rides on the main timesheet instead of its own document. The enabled-set (inv_is_enabled = 1) is seeded out-of-repo.

timesheet
overtime

fields.description: Which of the up-to-4 documents this component lands on. gosi_fee / charge_fee ride on main (see Rides On).
fields.label: Target Document

fields.description: D8 present-set. 1 = this client receives this component. The enabled set is seeded out-of-repo; a fired-but-unenabled component raises present_set_unconfirmed.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: own_document = spawns its own invoice; main_timesheet = rides on the main timesheet document (gosi_fee + charge_fee always ride on main).
fields.label: Rides On

fields.description: Effective-dated like the rate card; the rule in force on the period cutoff applies.
